Description:
  Check PHP code for complexity and structural issues

Usage:
  check [options] [--] [<paths>...]

Arguments:
  paths                                        Paths to analyze [default: auto-detect from composer.json]

Options:
      --preset=PRESET                          Apply a named preset (strict, legacy, ci) or path to preset file (can be repeated or comma-separated) (multiple values allowed)
      --exclude=EXCLUDE                        Directories to exclude (can be repeated) (multiple values allowed)
      --suppress-path=SUPPRESS-PATH            Suppress violations for files matching path prefix or glob pattern (can be repeated, e.g., src/Entity, src/Metrics/*Visitor.php) (multiple values allowed)
      --suppress-namespace=SUPPRESS-NAMESPACE  Suppress violations for classes in namespace matching prefix or glob pattern (can be repeated, e.g., App\Entity, App\*Repository) (multiple values allowed)
      --include-generated                      Include files marked with @generated annotation (skipped by default)
  -c, --config=CONFIG                          Path to configuration file
  -f, --format=FORMAT                          Output format (summary, text, json, checkstyle, sarif, gitlab, github, metrics, health, html, suppressed). Default: summary
  -o, --output=OUTPUT                          Write output to file instead of stdout (atomic write)
      --fail-on=FAIL-ON                        Minimum severity to trigger non-zero exit code (none, warning, error). Default: error. Exit codes: 0 = clean, 1 = warnings, 2 = errors, 3 = config/input error
      --namespace=NAMESPACE                    Filter results by namespace pattern: boundary-aware prefix, or glob when it contains * ? [
      --class=CLASS                            Filter results by class FQCN (exact match)
      --no-cache                               Disable caching
      --cache-dir=CACHE-DIR                    Cache directory
      --clear-cache                            Clear cache before analysis
      --baseline=BASELINE                      Path to baseline file for filtering known violations
      --show-resolved                          Show count of baseline entries resolved since baseline
      --show-suppressed                        Show suppressed violations as prose; --format=suppressed reports the same composition as machine-readable JSON
      --no-suppression-annotations             Report findings that `@qmx-ignore` annotations suppress (does not change what a baseline measures)
      --report=REPORT                          Scope of violations to report (e.g., git:main..HEAD)
      --report-strict                          Only show violations exactly in changed files (exclude parent namespaces)
  -w, --workers=WORKERS                        Number of parallel workers (0 = disable parallel, default: auto-detect)
      --log-file=LOG-FILE                      Write debug log to file
      --log-level=LOG-LEVEL                    Minimum log level (debug, info, warning, error) [default: "info"]
      --no-progress                            Disable progress bar
      --memory-limit=MEMORY-LIMIT              PHP memory limit (e.g., 512M, 1G, -1 for unlimited)
      --profile[=PROFILE]                      Enable profiling and export to file (or show summary if no file specified) [default: false]
      --profile-format=PROFILE-FORMAT          Profile export format (json or chrome-tracing) [default: "json"]
      --group-by=GROUP-BY                      Group violations by: none, file, rule, severity, class, namespace (default: formatter-specific)
      --format-opt=FORMAT-OPT                  Formatter-specific option (format: key=value) (multiple values allowed)
      --detail[=DETAIL]                        Show detailed violations (default: 200, --detail=all for unlimited, --detail=N for custom limit) [default: false]
      --top=TOP                                Number of top impact issues to show (default 10, 0 to disable)
      --all                                    Show all violations without truncation (alias for --format-opt=violations=all --detail=all)
      --exclude-health=EXCLUDE-HEALTH          Exclude health dimension from scoring (complexity, cohesion, coupling, typing, maintainability) (multiple values allowed)
      --disable-rule=DISABLE-RULE              Disable a rule or group by prefix (e.g., complexity, size.class-count). Disabling duplication.clone also skips the memory-intensive detection phase (multiple values allowed)
      --only-rule=ONLY-RULE                    Run only specified rules or group by prefix (e.g., complexity, code-smell) (multiple values allowed)
      --rule-opt=RULE-OPT                      Rule-specific option (format: rule-name:option=value) (multiple values allowed)
  -h, --help                                   Display help for the given command. When no command is given display help for the list command
      --silent                                 Do not output any message
  -q, --quiet                                  Only errors are displayed. All other output is suppressed
  -V, --version                                Display this application version
      --ansi|--no-ansi                         Force (or disable --no-ansi) ANSI output
  -n, --no-interaction                         Do not ask any interactive question
  -d, --working-dir=WORKING-DIR                Use the given directory as working directory
  -v|vv|vvv, --verbose                         Increase the verbosity of messages: 1 for normal output, 2 for more verbose output and 3 for debug

Help:
  Run bin/qmx rules to see all available rules and their options.
  Use --rule-opt=rule-name:option=value to set rule-specific thresholds.
